content: USENIX Security 2026 (ETH Zurich) found 25 zero-knowledge violations across Bitwarden/LastPass/Dashlane under a malicious-server threat model: per-field (not per-blob) encryption leaks metadata (which fields exist / cut-and-paste substitution across items); unauthenticated public keys and missing crypto binding between data and metadata let a malicious server swap keys during account-recovery/enterprise-reset flows to trick the client into wrapping vault keys for an attacker-controlled key. Root causes: insufficient key separation, no ciphertext integrity binding, missing authenticated key exchange for recovery flows.
